# Reverend Jo

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c24 P21](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0021)</sub>
- **Role:** Theological student and minister  <sub>[v2 c24 P9](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0009), [v2 c27 P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jo  <sub>[v2 c23 P13](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0013)</sub>; Jonas  <sub>[v2 c24 P8](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0008)</sub>

## Appearance

He is an exceptionally ugly young man with a large, loose-jointed figure and very long legs. He has lank tow-colored hair, green eyes, an enormous mouth, and prominent ears, though his face is illuminated by a broad intellectual brow and inspired eyes when preaching.

_Sources: [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P15](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0015)_

## Personality

He possesses a sweet, generous nature, a wonderful humor, and a beautiful soul and disposition. Earnest and deeply devout in his calling, he is nevertheless cheerful, tolerant, and capable of jesting and laughing freely.

_Sources: [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P12](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0012), [v2 c24 P15](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0015), [v2 c25 P15](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0015)_

## Traits

- Ugly  <sub>[v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010)</sub>
- Good-tempered  <sub>[v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010)</sub>
- Earnest and devout  <sub>[v2 c24 P15](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0015)</sub>
- Cheerful and humorous  <sub>[v2 c24 P12](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0012), [v2 c25 P15](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0015)</sub>
- Loves music and has a lovely voice  <sub>[v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010)</sub>

## Abilities

- Inspiring and eloquent preaching  <sub>[v2 c24 P15](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- To serve as a minister and labor among the needy in the slums  <sub>[v2 c24 P19](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0019), [v2 c27 P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029)</sub>

## History

Jonas Blake attended Redmond College, graduating before studying theology at St. Columbia. While serving a summer pastorate at Prospect Point Mission Church, he met Philippa Gordon, who fell in love with him despite his homely appearance and initial hesitation. Though he struggled against entering the ministry in his youth, he eventually embraced his calling. After completing his theological studies, he was called to a mission church in the slums of Patterson Street. He married Philippa Gordon the June following her graduation from Redmond.

_Sources: [v2 c24 P9](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0009), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P19](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0019), [v2 c27 P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 c39 P40](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0040)_

- Graduated from Redmond College  <sub>[v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c27 P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029)</sub>

- In charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church during one summer  <sub>[v2 c24 P9](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0009)</sub>

## Quotes

> I tried to be something else for a long time—I didn’t want to be a minister. But I came to see at last that it was the work given me to do—and God helping me, I shall try to do it.  <sub>[v2 c24 P19](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0019)</sub>
